item.title: Two Saudi airports targeted on Monday as fighting with Yemen's Houthis escalates
item.description: Saudi Arabia's airports in Jazan and Najran were targeted in two attacks on Monday evening, injuring three people and causing limited damage, the Saudi aviation authority said, as hostilities between the kingdom and Yemen's Iran-backed Houthis escalated.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Saudi Arabia's airports in Jazan and Najran were targeted in two attacks on Monday evening, injuring three people and causing limited damage, the Saudi aviation authority said, as hostilities between the kingdom and Yemen's Iran-backed Houthis escalated. The attacks came as Saudi-backed Yemeni government forces pressed a [USN:L1N45R06H TEXT:"major offensive"] to retake territory from the Houthis after weeks of rebel advances, with Riyadh stepping up airstrikes in support of the campaign. The Houthis have responded with missile and drone attacks on targets in Saudi Arabia, including airports, oil facilities and military sites. Saudi Arabia's General Authority of Civil Aviation said it was assessing the damage at the King Abdullah Bin Abdulaziz International Airport and Najran International Airport and taking measures to ensure the safety of passengers and staff and the security of the kingdom's civil aviation system.

item.title: Un juez de EEUU bloquea la política de Trump de multar a migrantes con hasta 1,8 millones de dólares
item.description: Un juez federal de Estados Unidos bloqueó el lunes los esfuerzos del Gobierno de Donald Trump por imponer multas de hasta 1,8 millones de dólares a los migrantes que no abandonen el país tras recibir órdenes definitivas de deportación.
item.dc:creator: Nate Raymond
item.content:encoded: Un juez federal de Estados Unidos bloqueó el lunes los esfuerzos del Gobierno de Donald Trump por imponer multas de hasta 1,8 millones de dólares a los migrantes que no abandonen el país tras recibir órdenes definitivas de deportación. El juez federal de distrito George O'Toole, en Boston, dictó la resolución en una demanda colectiva presentada el año pasado por dos de los miles de migrantes a los que el Departamento de Seguridad Nacional (DHS, por sus siglas en inglés) ha impuesto sanciones civiles. El magistrado afirmó que el Gobierno impuso las multas de forma ilegal. O'Toole dijo que era necesario suspender las políticas relacionadas con esas sanciones porque su cobro probablemente llevaría a los demandantes a la insolvencia. "Los demandantes viven en una situación económica precaria incluso sin que se les impongan las exorbitantes multas del Gobierno", escribió. El DHS no hizo comentarios de inmediato. El pasado julio, el departamento informó de que había impuesto más de 103.000 multas a migrantes por un total de unos 84.000 millones de dólares desde que el presidente Donald Trump regresó a la Casa Blanca el año pasado. Aunque el Congreso autorizó las sanciones civiles mediante la Ley de Reforma de la Inmigración Ilegal y Responsabilidad de los Inmigrantes de 1996, ningún Gobierno intentó imponerlas hasta el primer mandato de Trump. Desde el año pasado, el segundo Gobierno de Trump comenzó a imponer multas de 998 dólares diarios a los migrantes que no abandonaran Estados Unidos tras recibir una orden de deportación. Esas multas se han aplicado de forma retroactiva por períodos de hasta cinco años, con una sanción máxima de 1,8 millones de dólares. En julio de 2025, el DHS y el Departamento de Justicia de Estados Unidos implantaron un nuevo procedimiento que, dijeron, agilizaría la imposición de multas al eliminar un plazo de notificación previa de 30 días y acortar el procedimiento para impugnar las sanciones. Los demandantes, entre los que también figuraba el Centro de Recursos Legales para Inmigrantes, impugnaron esa política, así como lo que describieron como una práctica del Servicio de Inmigración y Control de Aduanas de Estados Unidos (ICE, por sus siglas en inglés), una agencia del DHS, consistente en imponer multas mediante formularios estandarizados sin evaluar de manera independiente si la persona había incumplido la obligación de salir del país de forma "deliberada" o "voluntaria". O'Toole, nombrado por el presidente demócrata Bill Clinton, dio la razón a los demandantes y determinó que las multas eran ilegales e infringían la Ley de Procedimiento Administrativo, porque los formularios carecían de alegaciones específicas que explicaran por qué la conducta de una persona justificaba una sanción. También concluyó que el Gobierno había incumplido los procedimientos de elaboración de normas al adoptar su sistema agilizado de imposición de multas, porque no había ofrecido previamente al público la oportunidad de presentar comentarios sobre el cambio de política.

item.title: Lane, del BCE, no ve fuertes efectos de segunda ronda sobre la inflación
item.description: Los elevados costos energéticos de la zona euro aún no han generado efectos de segunda ronda sobre la inflación, y la intensidad de esa transmisión es incierta, dijo el economista jefe del Banco Central Europeo, Philip Lane, a la agencia de noticias italiana ANSA.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Los elevados costos energéticos de la zona euro aún no han generado efectos de segunda ronda sobre la inflación, y la intensidad de esa transmisión es incierta, dijo el economista jefe del Banco Central Europeo, Philip Lane, a la agencia de noticias italiana ANSA. "Hasta ahora no hemos observado efectos de segunda ronda muy fuertes. Seguimos vigilándolos", dijo Lane en una entrevista publicada el martes. "Por eso, aunque defiendo el uso de escenarios, es demasiado simplista decir que estamos en el escenario adverso o en el escenario base". "Los precios de la energía son altos, pero la intensidad de su transmisión al resto de la economía sigue siendo incierta", añadió Lane.

item.title: ¿Quién puede ser nominado al Premio Nobel y quién puede presentar candidatos?
item.description: Este 2026, el galardón celebra 125 años de reconocer las grandes aportaciones científicas y humanitarias. Así es su cuidado proceso de selección.
item.dc:creator: Isaac Garrido
item.content:encoded: Los Premios Nobel 2026 han comenzado a anunciar a sus laureados. El primero fue el Nobel de Fisiología o Medicina otorgado a Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann y Georg Nagel por sus descubrimientos en el campo de la optogenética. El anuncio ha reavivado una de las grandes interrogantes que rodean al galardón: ¿cómo se elige a los ganadores? ¿Quiénes pueden ser nominados? ¿Existe una lista? Las respuestas están en el testamento de Alfred Nobel y el estatuto de los premios, documentos que establecen las reglas del proceso de selección y nominación. Según las reglas, pueden ser nominadas las personas cuya obra, descubrimiento, investigación o labor corresponda con los criterios establecidos para cada categoría del Nobel. En el caso del Premio de la Paz, también pueden ser postuladas organizaciones o instituciones. La última voluntad de Nobel estableció qué instituciones debían encargarse de seleccionar a los laureados: la Real Academia Sueca de Ciencias para los premios de Física y Química; el Instituto Karolinska para Fisiología o Medicina y la Academia Sueca para Literatura. El proceso actual para la elección del Nobel comienza en septiembre del año previo, cuando miles de miembros de academias, profesores universitarios, científicos, ganadores del Nobel, integrantes de asambleas parlamentarias y otras personas reciben una invitación para proponer candidatos a los Premios Nobel del año siguiente. El Nobel de la Paz, recibido en 2025 por la venezolana María Corina Machado , es el único que no requiere de una carta-invitación. Las nominaciones deben recibirse a más tardar el 31 de enero del año del premio y de febrero a septiembre las postulaciones son revisadas por un Comité Nobel de entre cinco y 10 integrantes, que analiza a los candidatos, consulta a expertos y reduce la lista. En octubre, las instituciones encargadas de otorgar cada premio realizan la votación final y el primer lunes del mes comienza la semana de anuncios. En 2026, se extenderán hasta el 12 de octubre. Las reglas oficiales además señalan que “nadie puede nominarse a sí mismo” y que “los nombres de los nominados no pueden revelarse hasta 50 años después”. La restricción se extiende a los nominadores “Cualquier rumor sobre nominaciones recientes es simplemente eso: un rumor, o bien información filtrada por alguno de los nominadores invitados”, explica el sitio de Nobel. “Cabe señalar que, en algunos casos, los archivos permanecen cerrados mientras las personas mencionadas sigan con vida”, agrega. La restricción también aplica a las investigaciones y deliberaciones relacionadas con la concesión de un premio. El nombre de algunos nominados se puede revelar cuando hayan cumplido el periodo de confidencialidad” y en el sitio oficial se puede consultar un archivo con toda esa información.

item.title: DeepSeek captará al menos 12.000 millones de dólares en ronda respaldada por Tencent, según Bloomberg
item.description: La empresa emergente china de inteligencia artificial DeepSeek está cerca de conseguir al menos 80.000 millones de yuanes (11.930 millones de dólares) en su última ronda de financiación, informó el martes Bloomberg News, que citó a personas familiarizadas con el asunto.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La empresa emergente china de inteligencia artificial DeepSeek está cerca de conseguir al menos 80.000 millones de yuanes (11.930 millones de dólares) en su última ronda de financiación, informó el martes Bloomberg News, que citó a personas familiarizadas con el asunto. El fabricante chino de baterías CATL (300750.SZ) y Tencent Holdings (0700.HK) han comprometido algunas de las mayores aportaciones de la actual ronda de financiación, según el artículo. DeepSeek buscaba inicialmente unos 50.000 millones de yuanes, pero la demanda de los inversores superó las expectativas tras el exitoso lanzamiento de su último modelo de IA, señaló Bloomberg News, que añadió que el importe final podría acercarse a los 100.000 millones de yuanes. DeepSeek, Tencent y CATL no respondieron de inmediato a las solicitudes de comentarios de Reuters. Reuters no pudo verificar de inmediato la información. DeepSeek se asoció recientemente con Huawei Technologies para desarrollar herramientas de programación optimizadas para los chips de IA Ascend de Huawei, lo que pone de relieve los esfuerzos de China por reducir su dependencia del ecosistema de IA de Nvidia (NVDA.O) . El mes pasado, la empresa lanzó su último modelo, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, y afirmó que estaba diseñado para ofrecer mayores capacidades, una inferencia más rápida, una mayor capacidad de procesamiento y la posibilidad de escalar a modelos más grandes. DeepSeek había contratado a CITIC Securities para preparar una posible salida a bolsa en el mercado STAR, aunque el calendario, la valoración y el importe que se captaría siguen sin decidirse, informó Reuters el mes pasado. (1 dólar = 6,7045 yuanes chinos)

item.title: UK probes Meta over risk assessment of Instagram Instants
item.description: Britain's communications regulator said on Tuesday it has opened an investigation into whether Meta Platforms breached UK online safety laws by failing to properly assess risks posed by its Instagram Instants feature before launching it in May.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Britain's communications regulator said on Tuesday it has opened an investigation into whether Meta Platforms (META.O) breached UK online safety laws by failing to properly assess risks posed by its Instagram Instants feature before launching it in May. Instants allows content shared by users in social media platform Instagram to disappear after being viewed. Ofcom said its formal investigation would establish if Meta carried out a "suitable and sufficient" assessments into the risk of illegal content in the feature or any possible risks posed to children before launch. George Lusty, director of enforcement at Ofcom, said: "Our online safety laws are clear – significant changes to platforms must be risk assessed before they're launched." He said safety by design had to be built in and not bolted on. "Today’s investigation shows we'll take action where we have concerns that providers are failing to comply," he added. Meta said it took its regulatory obligations under the Online Safety Act seriously. "We conducted a risk analysis and briefed Ofcom about this feature on a number of occasions before launching it," a spokesperson said. "Instants has in-built protections, including blocking screenshots, reshares and forwarding, no public feed, and Teen Account protections on automatically." "We will of course co-operate with Ofcom during this investigation," it added. Meta has launched legal challenges against Ofcom over its implementation of the Online Safety Act, including the scale and the scope of the information it has to provide to the regulator, and the level of fees it charges.

item.title: OpenAI y Anthropic dicen a Australia que verían con buenos ojos las normas sobre brechas de datos
item.description: OpenAI y Anthropic comunicaron el martes al Parlamento australiano que acogerían con agrado una legislación que les obligara a notificar las filtraciones de datos provocadas por sus agentes de inteligencia artificial, y reconocieron que, en la actualidad, la decisión de notificarlas a las autoridades queda a su discreción.
item.dc:creator: Byron Kaye
item.content:encoded: OpenAI y Anthropic comunicaron el martes al Parlamento australiano que acogerían con agrado una legislación que les obligara a notificar las filtraciones de datos provocadas por sus agentes de inteligencia artificial, y reconocieron que, en la actualidad, la decisión de notificarlas a las autoridades queda a su discreción. Estas declaraciones se producen tras la polémica suscitada cuando OpenAI, creadora de ChatGPT, tardó tres meses en informar al Gobierno australiano de que uno de sus agentes había violado la seguridad del principal portal sanitario del país. Un número cada vez mayor de australianos también reclama normas más estrictas en materia de centros de datos de IA y protección de los derechos de autor de la IA, mientras el Gobierno del primer ministro Anthony Albanese trabaja en nuevas leyes para regular el sector. Tanto OpenAI como Anthropic, creadora de Claude, están a la espera de la autorización para los grandes centros de datos previstos por las promotoras en Australia, donde han acordado ser los principales compradores de capacidad de cómputo. "Apoyaríamos un marco de divulgación obligatoria", dijo Jason Kwon, director de estrategia de OpenAI, en una audiencia celebrada en Sídney. Cuando OpenAI tuvo conocimiento de la filtración de datos del sitio web de salud australiano y de otros tres sitios web gubernamentales, "estábamos tratando de seguir un proceso, intentábamos establecer una norma que se pudiera aplicar", explicó Kwon ante la comisión de investigación. "Esa es una función que puede desempeñar una medida legal. Los representantes de la sociedad deben tomar más decisiones para que no seamos nosotros quienes tomemos todas estas decisiones". Anthropic también ha sufrido varios incidentes en los que sus agentes han perpetrado ataques informáticos, y su responsable de políticas para Australia y Nueva Zelanda, David Masters, también dijo ante la comisión de investigación que la empresa estaría dispuesta a acatar las leyes australianas que exijan a las empresas de IA revelar las violaciones de datos. En EEUU se ha presentado una legislación federal que obligaría a las empresas de IA a informar de comportamientos peligrosos, como los intentos de eludir la supervisión humana. Sin embargo, actualmente no existe ningún sistema de notificación de incidentes que exija de forma generalizada a las empresas revelar los comportamientos peligrosos de la IA cuando se detecten.

item.title: AMD will Chip-Produktion kräftig ausweiten
item.description: Der US-Halbleiterhersteller AMD reagiert auf die hohe Nachfrage nach Computerchips mit einer Ausweitung der Produktion. "Wir haben unser Angebot 2026 bereits gesteigert und werden es 2027 noch einmal deutlich erhöhen", sagte Konzernchefin Lisa Su am Dienstag auf einer Pressekonferenz in Taipeh. Ihr Besuch in Taiwan diene dazu, sich bei den Auftragsfertigern TSMC und Foxconn entsprechende Kapazitäten zu sichern. Sie arbeite zudem eng mit den südkoreanischen Konzernen Samsung und SK Hynix zusammen, um die Versorgung mit Speicherchips sicherzustellen. Diese sind derzeit weltweit knapp. Su will in den kommenden Tagen nach Südkorea reisen.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Der US-Halbleiterhersteller AMD (AMD.O) reagiert auf die hohe Nachfrage nach Computerchips mit einer Ausweitung der Produktion. "Wir haben unser Angebot 2026 bereits gesteigert und werden es 2027 noch einmal deutlich erhöhen", sagte Konzernchefin Lisa Su am Dienstag auf einer Pressekonferenz in Taipeh. Ihr Besuch in Taiwan diene dazu, sich bei den Auftragsfertigern TSMC (2330.TW) und Foxconn (2317.TW) entsprechende Kapazitäten zu sichern. Sie arbeite zudem eng mit den südkoreanischen Konzernen Samsung (005930.KS) und SK Hynix (000660.KS) zusammen, um die Versorgung mit Speicherchips sicherzustellen. Diese sind derzeit weltweit knapp. Su will in den kommenden Tagen nach Südkorea reisen. Auf die Frage, ob sich AMD am Bau eines möglichen neuen TSMC-Werks im US-Bundesstaat Texas beteiligen würde, antwortete Su nicht direkt. "Die Nachfrage wird in den nächsten Jahren sehr, sehr hoch sein. Deshalb brauchen wir mehr Kapazitäten für die Produktion hochmoderner Wafer." Ihr Unternehmen plane derzeit drei bis fünf Jahre voraus. AMD ist der weltweit zweitgrößte Anbieter von KI-Hochleistungsprozessoren hinter Nvidia (NVDA.O) . Das US-Unternehmen profitiert davon, dass Abnehmer nach Alternativen zum Weltmarktführer suchen. In den vergangenen Monaten eilte AMD dank des Booms beim Ausbau von Rechenzentren für Künstliche Intelligenz (KI) von [USN:L8N44139V TEXT:"Rekordergebnis"] zu Rekordergebnis.

item.title: Las bolsas europeas suben ante el repunte de Genmab y el retroceso de los rendimientos de los bonos
item.description: Las bolsas europeas subían el martes hasta situarse cerca de sus máximos de la semana, con Genmab a la cabeza de las ganancias en el sector sanitario, mientras que los rendimientos de los bonos de la zona del euro se tomaban un respiro tras el repunte provocado por las preocupaciones sobre las finanzas públicas y la inflación.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Las bolsas europeas subían el martes hasta situarse cerca de sus máximos de la semana, con Genmab a la cabeza de las ganancias en el sector sanitario, mientras que los rendimientos de los bonos de la zona del euro se tomaban un respiro tras el repunte provocado por las preocupaciones sobre las finanzas públicas y la inflación. El índice paneuropeo STOXX 600 (.STOXX) subía un 0,8%, hasta los 638,41 puntos, a las 0727 GMT, a punto de registrar su tercera sesión consecutiva de ganancias. Genmab (GMAB.CO) subía un 7,6% hasta situarse a la cabeza del STOXX 600 después de que la combinación de medicamentos contra el cáncer de sangre desarrollada por la empresa danesa de biotecnología y la farmacéutica estadounidense AbbVie (ABBV.N) redujera el riesgo de progresión de la enfermedad o de muerte en un estudio en fase avanzada. El sector sanitario en su conjunto (.SXDP) avanzaba un 1,6%. La atención se centra ahora en los datos de ventas minoristas de la zona euro y en la encuesta del PMI de S&P Global de Reino Unido, que se publicarán más tarde hoy y que podrían ofrecer pistas sobre el gasto de los consumidores de la región y la actividad económica británica. [USN:L6N45S08O TEXT:"El euro"] se mantenía cerca de su mínimo de 17 meses, lastrado por la incertidumbre política tras la convocatoria de [USN:L6N45R0A1 TEXT:"elecciones anticipadas"] por parte del presidente del Gobierno español, Pedro Sánchez, el lunes. Mientras tanto, el Gobierno francés está tratando de aprobar un [USN:L6N45N0JG TEXT:"impopular presupuesto"] para 2027 con el fin de reducir su déficit, lo que ha provocado una caída en picado de los bonos. Aun así, los rendimientos de los bonos de la zona euro se moderaban, tras haber alcanzado máximos de varias décadas la semana pasada. Entre otras acciones, la italiana Technoprobe (TPRO.MI) subía un 2,3% después de que JP Morgan iniciara la cobertura de la acción con una recomendación de "sobreponderar".

item.title: Lane (EZB) mahnt inmitten von Anleihemarkt-Turbulenzen zu weitsichtiger Etatpolitik
item.description: Angesichts der gestiegenen Renditen für Staatsanleihen hat EZB-Chefvolkswirt Philip Lane die Regierungen zu einer weitsichtigen Haushaltspolitik gemahnt. "Wichtig ist, dass Regierungen über den unmittelbaren Horizont hinausblicken", sagte er in einem am Dienstag veröffentlichten Interview der italienischen Nachrichtenagentur Ansa. Die Regierungen müssen ihre Haushalte für 2027 festlegen. Doch angesichts der Herausforderungen der kommenden fünf oder zehn Jahre sei es entscheidend, die langfristigen Zinsen zu berücksichtigen. Ebenso wichtig sei der Blick auf das Wirtschaftswachstum: "Die Regierungen müssen hierbei realistisch bleiben und die Zinssätze einplanen, mit denen sie in den nächsten Jahren konfrontiert sein werden", sagte Lane.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Angesichts der gestiegenen Renditen für Staatsanleihen hat EZB-Chefvolkswirt Philip Lane die Regierungen zu einer weitsichtigen Haushaltspolitik gemahnt. "Wichtig ist, dass Regierungen über den unmittelbaren Horizont hinausblicken", sagte er in einem am Dienstag veröffentlichten Interview der italienischen Nachrichtenagentur Ansa. Die Regierungen müssen ihre Haushalte für 2027 festlegen. Doch angesichts der Herausforderungen der kommenden fünf oder zehn Jahre sei es entscheidend, die langfristigen Zinsen zu berücksichtigen. Ebenso wichtig sei der Blick auf das Wirtschaftswachstum: "Die Regierungen müssen hierbei realistisch bleiben und die Zinssätze einplanen, mit denen sie in den nächsten Jahren konfrontiert sein werden", sagte Lane. Im Fokus steht derzeit der Haushaltsentwurf der französischen Regierung für 2027, der Ausgabenkürzungen und Sparmaßnahmen enthält und von Protesten begleitet wird. Anleger zeigen sich jedoch skeptisch, ob die Regierung in Paris ihr Defizit vor den Wahlen 2027 in den Griff bekommt. Dies sorgte dafür, dass die Rendite der zehnjährigen französischen Staatsanleihen jüngst in der Nähe ihres höchsten Standes seit 2008 blieb.

item.title: Ukrainian drones kill two in Moscow region, injure nine more, governor says
item.description: Ukrainian drone attacks overnight on Tuesday killed two people and injured nine more in the Moscow region surrounding the Russian capital, Governor Andrei Vorobyov said.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Ukrainian drone attacks overnight on Tuesday killed two people and injured nine more in the Moscow region surrounding the Russian capital, Governor Andrei Vorobyov said. More than 650 Ukrainian drones were launched in a wave headed towards Moscow overnight, the city's mayor Sergei Sobyanin said earlier on Tuesday, adding that most of them were downed. The dead included a 71-year-old man pulled from under the rubble of a house and a 20-year-old man found in a nearby village, Vorobyov said. A warehouse was also set ablaze, local authorities were cited as saying by the TASS state news agency. The head of the city of Domodedovo, south of Moscow and home to the country's third-largest airport of the same name, said work was being done to restore electricity to villages that had been hit by drones. (This story has been corrected to remove an erroneous reference to a Wildberries warehouse in paragraph 3.)

item.title: サイバー攻撃による情報流出続発、「大変深刻に受け止め」＝官房長官
item.description: [東京 ６日 ロイター] - 木原稔官房長官は６日午後の会見で、企業や団体に対してサイバー攻撃が行われ情報が流出する...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
サイバー攻撃による情報流出続発、「大変深刻に受け止め」＝官房長官 16:48 配信

木原稔官房長官。7月14日、都内で撮影。REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon

[東京 ６日 ロイター] - 木原稔官房長官は６日午後の会見で、企業や団体に対してサイバー攻撃が行われ情報が流出する事案が続発していることについて、「大変深刻に受け止めている」と述べた。

現在、政府として被害の全体像の把握に努めており、「流出した個人情報が悪用されると二次被害につながることから、パスワードの使い回しをやめ多要素認証を利用すること、また不審なメールに注意することなどを呼びかけている」とした。

また海外のサイバーセキュリティ関係機関・捜査当局との連携による情報収集も行っているとしたうえで、「サイバー攻撃の被害を受けた場合、早期に所管省庁や警察等の関係機関への通報、相談をお願いしたい」と呼びかけた。

ロイター 関連ニュース オープンＡＩのエージェント、5月にルビージェムズを攻撃＝研究者 ＡＩ活用サイバー攻撃に社会全体で防衛強化を、テック大手が共同書簡 独企業、外国諜報機関の関与疑われるサイバー攻撃被害が増加＝調査 独シーメンス、米当局のハッカー警告に「攻撃増はない」と返答 コラム：サイバー攻撃のリスク、顧客だけでなく保険業界も動揺 最終更新: 10/6(火) 16:48 ロイター

item.title: Kaur steps down as India women's team captain
item.description: World Cup-winning skipper Harmanpreet Kaur announced on Tuesday her decision to step down from her role as captain of the Indian women's team in all formats.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: World Cup-winning skipper Harmanpreet Kaur announced on Tuesday her decision to step down from her role as captain of the Indian women's team in all formats. The 37-year-old captained India in five tests, 51 one-day internationals and 155 Twenty20 internationals, leading the side to their first-ever 50-over World Cup triumph on home soil last year. Under Kaur, India also won two T20 Asian Cup titles and two Asian Games gold medals, [USN:L6N45E03V TEXT:"most recently last month"] at the Aichi-Nagoya Games. "Today, I step down as captain of the Indian women's cricket team across all formats," Kaur wrote on social media. "This is not an easy decision. It carries years of memories, emotions, sacrifices, and moments that will stay with me for the rest of my life." Indian media said Kaur's decision came a day after she met Devajit Saikia, secretary of the Indian cricket board (BCCI), to discuss the future of the women's team. Kaur, who became this year the [USN:L4N3ZF0ZT TEXT:"highest-capped player in women's international cricket"], said she intended to keep on playing. "I gave this team everything I had," she added. "I carried the responsibility with pride, and I will always be grateful for the privilege of leading Indian women's cricket. "Now, I'm ready to play for the love of the game again. Captaincy ends. The journey continues."

item.title: 中国ディープシーク、少なくとも120億ドル調達へ＝通信社
item.description: [６日 ロイター] - 中国の新興人工知能（ＡＩ）企業ディープシークは、最新の資金調達ラウンドで少なくとも８００億元...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
中国ディープシーク、少なくとも120億ドル調達へ＝通信社 16:45 配信

ディープシークのロゴ。2025年1月29日撮影のイメージ写真。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration

[６日 ロイター] - 中国の新興人工知能（ＡＩ）企業ディープシークは、最新の資金調達ラウンドで少なくとも８００億元（１１９億３０００万ドル）を確保する見通しとなった。ブルームバーグ・ニュースが６日、関係者の話として報じた。

報道によると、中国の電池大手、寧徳時代新能源科技（ＣＡＴＬ）と騰訊控股（テンセント）が最大規模の出資を約束している。

ディープシークは当初、約５００億元の調達を目指していたが、最新ＡＩモデルの投入が成功し、投資家の需要が予想を上回ったという。最終的な調達額は１０００億元に迫る可能性があるとした。

ディープシークは９月、最新モデル「Ｖ４．１－Ｆｌａｓｈ」を公開した。機能の向上、推論の高速化、処理能力の拡大、より大規模なモデルへの拡張を目指して設計したと説明した。

ロイターは先月、ディープシークが上海証券取引所の新興ハイテク企業向け市場「科創板」での新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）準備に向けて中信証券を起用したと報じた。ただ、上場時期や企業評価額、調達規模は未定とされている。

item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US-Präsident Donald Trump hat die Hinrichtung eines ehemaligen Militärpsychiaters durch ein Erschießungskommando angeordnet, der 2009 bei einem Amoklauf auf dem Armeestützpunkt Fort Hood im Bundesstaat Texas 13 Menschen getötet hatte. Trump habe die Art der Exekution auf Vorschlag von Verteidigungsminister Pete Hegseth genehmigt, teilte das Pentagon am Montag auf der Online-Plattform X mit. Ort und Zeitpunkt der Vollstreckung werden noch festgelegt. Der verurteilte Täter Nidal Hasan hatte die Tat damals als Vergeltung für US-Kriege in der islamischen Welt bezeichnet. Sollte das Urteil gegen ihn vollstreckt werden, wäre dies die erste Exekution durch das US-Militär seit 1961. Damals wurde die Hinrichtung durch Erhängen vollzogen. Die letzte Hinrichtung durch ein Erschießungskommando des US-Militärs fand im November 1945 statt. Die Ankündigung fällt mitten in die Debatte über die gescheiterte Hinrichtung einer verurteilten Mörderin im Bundesstaat Tennessee durch eine Giftspritze. Die Frau wurde bewusstlos in ein Krankenhaus gebracht. Sie wird dort mit lebenserhaltenden Maßnahmen behandelt. Ihre Anwälte hatten gefordert, alternative Hinrichtungsmethoden wie Erhängen oder Erschießen zu prüfen, da sie Probleme beim Legen des intravenösen Zugangs für die Giftinjektion befürchteten. Der damalige Major Hasan hatte im November 2009 in einer medizinischen Einrichtung des Stützpunkts das Feuer eröffnet. Bei dem Angriff wurden zwölf unbewaffnete Soldaten im aktiven Dienst und ein pensionierter Soldat getötet sowie 32 weitere Menschen verletzt. Ein Militärgericht hatte Hasan im August 2013 wegen mehrfachen vorsätzlichen Mordes und versuchten Mordes zum Tode verurteilt. Hasan, der heute 56 Jahre alt ist, wurde bei seiner Festnahme von der Polizei angeschossen und ist seither teilweise gelähmt und auf den Rollstuhl angewiesen. Die Tat ereignete sich wenige Wochen vor seinem geplanten Auslandseinsatz in Afghanistan. Militärische Hinrichtungen sind in den USA äußerst selten. Nach dem Militärstrafrecht darf ein Todesurteil erst nach der Zustimmung des Präsidenten vollstreckt werden. Die Trump-Regierung hatte die zulässigen Methoden für Hinrichtungen auf Bundesebene vor dem Hintergrund von Engpässen bei Präparaten für die Giftspritze ausgeweitet. Neben dem Erschießungskommando gehören die Hinrichtung auf dem elektrischen Stuhl und durch Gas dazu. Nach Angaben des Death Penalty Information Center sind in mindestens fünf Bundesstaaten Erschießungskommandos für Hinrichtungen gesetzlich vorgesehen. Die zuletzt von Behörden der Bundesstaaten vollstreckte Hinrichtung durch Erschießen fand 2025 in South Carolina statt. Es war die erste in den USA seit 15 Jahren.

item.description: 南アジア経済堅調、今年度の印成長率見通し7.1％に上げ＝世銀 Reuters

item.title: 南アジア経済堅調、今年度の印成長率見通し7.1％に上げ＝世銀
item.description:
Shubham Batra
[ニューデリー ６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Shubham Batra

[ニューデリー ６日 ロイター] - 世界銀行は、エネルギーショックにもかかわらず消費者需要が堅調であることを理由に南アジアの成長見通しを引き上げた。ただ、原油価格の高止まり、深刻な気象ショック、世界的な市場の調整が地域の見通しを脅かす可能性があると警告した。

同地域の２０２６年の成長率を６．９％と予測。これは前回予測より６０ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）高く、１年前の予測を１０ｂｐ上回っている。

世銀のアジア担当チーフエコノミスト、フランツィスカ・オーンソルゲ氏は５日、ロイターとのインタビューで「消費者を保護するための政府の措置、堅調な送金、そして底堅い内需が、その（エネルギー価格上昇の）影響を和らげる一助となったためだ」と述べた。

地域最大の経済大国であるインドの２６／２７年度の成長率は７．１％と予測。６月時点の６．６％から上方修正されたものの、前年度に記録された８．６％よりは大幅に低い水準となる。

オーンソルゲ氏は「インフレ率は２７年にかけて高止まりが続くと予想される」と述べ、インフレ率の上昇が成長に影響を及ぼすまでには時間がかかる可能性があると付け加えた。「新興国市場において、こうしたショックと経済活動への影響との間に生じる通常のタイムラグは約１８カ月だ」と語った。

強いエルニーニョ現象が、特に農業が農村部の需要とインフレの鍵を握るインドにとって、さらなるリスクとなり得るとも指摘した。

世銀はまた、中期的な成長の勢いを維持するため、各国に対しＡＩ（人工知能）の導入を強く促した。

報告書は「より多く、より質の高い雇用を創出するための有望な手段の一つは、ＡＩの広範な導入だ。南アジアにおけるＡＩの導入は、先進国に比べて依然として大きく遅れているが、急速に追い上げている」と述べている。

同地域の経済成長の大部分を占めるインドでは、企業の約２３％がＡＩを利用していると報告しているのに対し、米国では４３％の企業がＡＩを利用していると報告している。

item.description: The South African rand was steady early on Tuesday, shrugging off a stronger US dollar even as weaker gold and platinum prices weighed on South Africa's export earnings and terms of trade.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The South African rand was steady early on Tuesday, shrugging off a stronger US dollar even as weaker gold and platinum prices weighed on South Africa's export earnings and terms of trade. At 0651 GMT the rand traded at 16.6325 against the dollar , little changed from its previous close of 16.6497 The US dollar index , which measures the greenback against a basket of currencies edged up, driven by easing expectations of a Federal Reserve interest rate hike this month Gold and platinum, South Africa's key exports, [USN:L1N45S05Z TEXT:"eased"] on Tuesday also pressured by the firmer dollar ETM Analytics said the rand has remained resilient despite a firmer US dollar, even as weak gold and platinum prices and elevated oil prices weighed "As an economy, SA remains vulnerable to more shocks. Still, the full effects can sometimes be masked by lower foreign participation... That should not be confused with a rising belief that SA is doing something right," said ETM Analytics in a note South Africa's benchmark 2035 government bond was firmer in early deals, as the yield fell 3.5 basis points to 8.85%

item.title: フィジカルＡＩは「勝ち筋、うまくやれば独壇場に」＝赤沢経産相
item.description: [東京 ６日 ロイター] - 赤沢亮正経済産業相は６日、都内で講演し、フィジカルＡＩ（人工知能）は「間違いなくわが国の勝...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
フィジカルＡＩは「勝ち筋、うまくやれば独壇場に」＝赤沢経産相 16:35 配信

日本のフィジカルAI政策を推進するイベントに出席した、赤沢亮正経済産業相、エヌビディアのフアンCEOら。7月16日、都内で撮影。REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon

[東京 ６日 ロイター] - 赤沢亮正経済産業相は６日、都内で講演し、フィジカルＡＩ（人工知能）は「間違いなくわが国の勝ち筋であり、うまくやれば独壇場になる。ＡＩロボットとフィジカルＡＩの開発にかなり賭けている」と強調した。 ＡＩ自体の開発では米国や中国に「今のところ歯が立たない」ものの、日本には「世界有数の製造現場と世界で唯一の（原発の）廃炉の現場がある」と述べ、こうした知見を活用することが日本の強みになるとの見方を示した。

赤沢氏は、中国がレアアースの「チョークポイント（急所）」を握って経済的威圧を行っている一方、「ＡＩや半導体を製造するにあたっての素材や製造装置は、日本がかなりチョーキングポイントを握っている」と指摘。「しっかり維持して日本の強みとして生かしていくのは当然だ」と語った。ＡＩ時代には「スタートアップの成功確率が劇的に高まる可能性がある」とも話し、「わが国のスタートアップ振興のための政策をもう一回、ゼロから抜本的に強力に見直したい」とした。

＜サハリン２の権益維持、かなり優先順位高い＞

経産省は同日、ウクライナ侵攻を続けるロシアに対する追加制裁として、ロシアの産業基盤強化に資する物品の輸出禁止措置を追加実施すると発表した。 赤沢氏は、ロシアの「侵略」は非難されるべきもので「われわれはウクライナサイドに立っている」とした上で、ロシア・サハリン州の石油・天然ガス開発事業「サハリン２」 については「日本の権益をきちっと維持することはかなり優先順位の高い課題」で、「そのことについて今ロシアとの間で何か問題を抱えているわけではない」と説明。同盟国も含めた了解を得た上で輸入されているとも述べた。

その上で、仮に日本が権益を手放せば「どこの国とは言わないが、他の国が入ってきて、われわれが開発に膨大な税金を費やしたものをただ持っていかれる。それが国益にかなうのかということも含めてやってきている」と語った。

＜ＡＩの開発速度巡る問題、米中の動向が鍵に＞

人工知能（ＡＩ）の開発速度を抑制すべきだとの主張については、危惧は理解するとした一方で「中国と米国両方が同意しない限りはあまり実効性がない」と指摘。一方が応じなければ「開発を続けた方が早く新しいものを開発することは目に見えている」と述べ、米中がルール作りに合意し、順守しなければ速度抑制の実現は難しいだろうと述べた。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：空前のＡＩ投資、相応の経済効果実現へなお高いハードル アングル：エヌビディア、ＡＩ半導体担保の巨大融資市場構想、資産価値巡りウォール街と溝 アングル：ＡＩ関連の資金調達、低格付け領域にも拡大　投資家は警戒感強める コラム：ベセント氏の危うい賭け、ＡＩ主導の経済成長は「債務病」の特効薬ならず コラム：ＩＴサービス企業、生成ＡＩ追い風に株価上昇か 最終更新: 10/6(火) 16:35 ロイター

item.title: Norway's biggest bank DNB to lay off around 400 staff amid AI-driven changes
item.description: DNB will lay off around 400 employees in its Technology & Services unit, Norway's largest bank said on Tuesday, citing increased investments in AI agents and digital solutions that had led to changes in the organization.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: DNB (DNB.OL) will lay off around 400 employees in its Technology & Services unit, Norway's largest bank said on Tuesday, citing increased investments in AI agents and digital solutions that had led to changes in the organization. “AI is changing the way we work and how we deliver services to our customers", the lender's CEO Kjerstin Braathen said in a statement, adding DNB was adapting to what she called "a new reality". DNB has adopted AI agents to replace tasks previously handled manually in some of its operations It expects to complete the job cuts during the last three months of 2026, with costs to be booked in the second quarter of 2027 With increased AI investments, companies globally have [USN:L8N43812F TEXT:"implemented massive layoffs"] with the goal of automating routine jobs DNB shares rose 1% following the announcement

item.title: France braces for day of school blockades and street protests
item.description: France braced on Tuesday for a day of nationwide high-school blockades and trade union-led street protests in support of students demanding that President Emmanuel Macron's cash-strapped government tackle understaffed and dilapidated schools.
item.dc:creator: Inti Landauro
item.content:encoded: France braced on Tuesday for a day of nationwide high-school blockades and trade union-led street protests in support of students demanding that President Emmanuel Macron's cash-strapped government tackle understaffed and dilapidated schools. Teenage students stood on barricades made of trash cans in front of schools from Lille in the north to Marseille in the south, and from Strasbourg in the east to Nantes in the west. In Paris they held up banners reading "We want to be heard, not teargassed" and "Our future is not optional". Tuesday's demonstrations come after a fortnight of protests which began in Paris's deprived suburbs before spreading across the country. The government responded with riot police, saying the movement had now morphed into urban violence. A teenager's hand was blown off as high-school protesters clashed with riot police in northern France on Monday. François-Xavier Lauch, prefect of Pas-de-Calais, declined to comment on the exact circumstances, saying some 200 to 250 protesters had been hurling objects at police. The regional newspaper La Voix du Nord said the 15-year-old lost his hand and part of his lower arm after picking up a police dispersal grenade. PRIME MINISTER PROMISES A RESPONSE Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu has ordered his ministers to tackle the students' leading demands. Those include ensuring absent teachers are replaced, reviewing the length of the 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. school day and the need for longer lunch breaks. The government would also look at repairs needed to ageing school buildings, said Lecornu, who demanded ministers send in their first proposals by the end of October. But finding spare cash will be difficult. The protests have piled pressure on a government trying to narrow a ballooning budget deficit as investor concerns about France's growing debt pile, weak growth and reluctance to rein in spending push bond yields higher. The yield on [USN:L8N45O0YO TEXT:"France's 10-year bonds "]briefly hit a 24-year high of over 5% last week. The surge in French borrowing costs has started to spill into the broader euro area, with the [USN:L6N45S0D2 TEXT:"sliding euro currency"] the latest alarm bell for policy makers. Finance Minister Roland Lescure said on Tuesday there was no need for the [USN:S8N3XB0C2 TEXT:"European Central Bank"] to step in. THOUSANDS OF ARRESTS France's Justice Ministry said 5,060 people have been arrested since the protests began, with 87% of them minors. More than 1,800 people are being prosecuted, including 1,483 minors, the ministry said, without specifying the crimes. It said 790 cases had been dismissed. At least 715 police officers and 215 teenagers have been injured in clashes, according to Lecornu's office. Six months before an election to replace Macron, his government and the far-right National Rally, led by presidential frontrunner Marine Le Pen, have accused hard-left France Unbowed (LFI) lawmakers and mayors of stoking the protests. The LFI denies the accusation. Bally Bagayoko, the LFI mayor of Saint-Denis, a poor Paris suburb, said he opposed violence but stood beside the protesting students. "I stand by being on the side of my residents, and high school students are my residents," he said.

item.title: European shares gain as Genmab jumps, bond yields retreat
item.description: European shares rose towards one-week highs on Tuesday, buoyed by gains in healthcare stocks after Genmab's upbeat drug-trial results, while euro zone bond yields took a breather after rallying on fiscal and inflation concerns.
item.dc:creator: Sudeshna Ghoshal
item.content:encoded: European shares rose towards one-week highs on Tuesday, buoyed by gains in healthcare stocks after Genmab's upbeat drug-trial results, while euro zone bond yields took a breather after rallying on fiscal and inflation concerns. The pan-European STOXX 600 (.STOXX) index was up 0.8% to 638.67 points by 0835 GMT, poised for a third straight session of gains. [USN:L4N45R1GW TEXT:"Genmab"] (GMAB.CO) climbed 7.7% to a three-year high after the Danish biotech firm and US drugmaker AbbVie (ABBV.N) 's combination treatment for patients newly diagnosed with a type of lymphoma reduced the risk of disease progression or death in a late-stage study. The broader healthcare index (.SXDP) was up 1.4%, leading sectoral gains in Europe. Attention now turns to euro zone retail sales data due later, which could offer clues about the region's consumer spending. Data also showed [USN:ZRN00EN1V TEXT:"UK construction activity fell"] in September, but the decline was the smallest since January. The euro hovered near a 17-month low, weighed down by worries over France's high debt burden and a political gridlock. Political uncertainty in the region deepened after Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez [USN:L8N45R05N TEXT:"called"] a snap election on Monday. "A new 2027 budget now looks unlikely, meaning Spain may again roll over its previous budget, keeping fiscal policy broadly steady and debt-to-GDP on a declining path," Danske Bank analysts said in a note. "We do not expect a near-term impact on growth or public finances, supported by strong employment and consumption, though tighter immigration policy could weigh on medium-term potential growth." Euro zone bond yields [USN:L6N45S0EJ TEXT:"eased"], having touched multi-decade highs last week. The spread between French and German 10-year yields narrowed further from its peak of last Friday as investors assessed whether the recent surge in France's risk premium had gone too far, too quickly. Persistently high rates raise borrowing costs for companies and mortgage holders, while increasing governments' interest burdens. MARKETS SCALE BACK ECB TIGHTENING BETS The recent turmoil in bond markets have prompted investors to dial back their expectations for interest rate hikes from the European Central Bank. Markets are now pricing in an 80% chance of another rate hike by the end of the year. They had been pricing in at least three more hikes by the March meeting but now are just fully pricing in one hike and around an 80% chance of a second. Among other stocks, Italy's Technoprobe (TPRO.MI) gained 4.5% after J.P.Morgan initiated coverage on the stock with an "overweight" rating. Spain's property developer Neinor Homes (HOME.MC) advanced 4.2% after raising its 2026-2027 outlook, unveiling 2028 targets and announcing a planned €200- €250 million ($225-$281 million) dividend for 2028.

item.title: Dabur India expects second quarter revenue, profit to grow in double digits
item.description: Indian consumer goods maker Dabur India said on Tuesday it expects consolidated revenue and profit after tax to grow by double digits in the second quarter, driven by its India consumer goods business and strong growth in international markets.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Indian consumer goods maker Dabur India (DABU.NS) said on Tuesday it expects consolidated revenue and profit after tax to grow by double digits in the second quarter, driven by its India consumer goods business and strong growth in international markets. Here are the details: The maker of Dabur Amla hair oil said its India FMCG business is expected to accelerate to double-digit growth for the quarter ended September 30, marking its strongest performance in recent quarters. Dabur said its margins were hit by Middle East-linked inflation in crude prices, which pushed up plastic packaging costs, though the impact was partly offset by further price hikes and cost-saving initiatives. Dabur's international business, despite severe headwinds in the Middle East, is expected to post high-teen growth in Indian rupee terms. Dabur expects its home and personal care business to post double-digit growth, with hair oils and shampoos likely to grow in the high teens, supported by demand for perfumed and coconut hair oils. The company said this would mark the fourth straight quarter of double-digit growth for the segment. Peer Marico (MRCO.NS) [USN:L4N45R055 TEXT:"said"] it expects second-quarter consolidated revenue to grow in double-digit percentages, while Godrej Consumer (GOCP.NS) [USN:L4N45L1NG TEXT:"expects"] consolidated revenue to rise in the high teens.

item.title: Vingroup, Alstom reach a deal for 200 Hanoi metro trainsets
item.description: Vietnam's Vingroup and France's Alstom have agreed to a deal for 200 metro trainsets and an associated technology transfer to support Hanoi's urban rail expansion, the companies said in a statement on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Vietnam's Vingroup (VIC.HM) and France's Alstom (ALSO.PA) have agreed to a deal for 200 metro trainsets and an associated technology transfer to support Hanoi's urban rail expansion, the companies said in a statement on Tuesday. Under the agreement, the first 83 five-car, fully automated driverless trainsets will be designed and built at Alstom's facility in France. Vingroup will manufacture and assemble the remaining 117 trainsets in Vietnam, with Alstom providing engineering expertise, tooling support and key components. The statement did not give a time frame for the deliveries. Urban rail is one of the fastest-growing segments of Vietnam's railway market, with a dozen lines planned in the country's main cities of Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City. Hanoi's urban rail network is planned to cover 979 km across 18 lines by 2045.

item.title: Britain likely to expel Israeli diplomats if Jerusalem consulate closes, sources say
item.description: Britain is likely to expel Israeli diplomats if Israel carries out its order to shut the British consulate in East Jerusalem this week in a dispute over sanctions targeting Israeli settlements, four sources said.
item.dc:creator: Alexander Cornwell
item.content:encoded: Britain is likely to expel Israeli diplomats if Israel carries out its [USN:S8N42N05Y TEXT:"order"] to shut the British consulate in East Jerusalem this week in a dispute over sanctions targeting Israeli settlements, four sources said. Israel on September 8 ordered Britain to close the East Jerusalem consulate within 30 days and remove its diplomats from the city, after Britain said it would impose [USN:S8N3X105I TEXT:"a ban"] on trade of goods made in Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank. The 30-day deadline for Britain to close the consulate ends on Thursday, which will impact around 30 British diplomats who work there, along with their family members, the sources said. If the consulate is closed, Britain is likely to respond by expelling a similar number of Israeli diplomats from Israel's embassy to the United Kingdom, the sources said, speaking on the condition of anonymity. The sources did not say how quickly Britain would act if the consulate closes. After Britain announced the sanctions, Israeli Foreign Minister Gideon Saar accused London of interfering in this month's Israeli general election. The British foreign office did not respond to a request for comment. The Israeli foreign ministry declined to comment. An Israeli official said any action against Israel would be met with a response. The British sanctions announcement, and Israel's response, marked a new low in the relationship between the once steadfast allies. Britain has repeatedly criticised Israel over its actions in the war in Gaza and over Israeli settler attacks on Palestinians. Israel's government has accused Britain's governing Labour party of being hostile towards Israel. The British consulate, in the Sheikh Jarrah neighbourhood of East Jerusalem, handles the country's relations with Palestinians in the city as well as in the West Bank and Gaza. It also provides consular services to Palestinians. The consulate has been in Jerusalem for almost 200 years, long before the State of Israel was established in 1948. Reuters reported on Monday that Britain's top national security adviser, Jonathan Powell, had [USN:L8N45R0TE TEXT:"quietly visited"] Israel last week in a bid to keep the consulate open but failed to reach an agreement. A fifth source said Britain was still hopeful an agreement could be reached. Two other sources said that Britain has asked European countries to raise the issue with Israel in hope of convincing the government to reverse its decision. A spokesperson for Israeli Foreign Minister Gideon Saar told Reuters on Monday the consulate would close on Thursday. In announcing the sanctions, Britain said that Israel's actions were undermining the possibility of a two-state solution — the idea of a Palestinian state co-existing peacefully alongside Israel. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's government openly rejects the idea of Palestinian statehood. Britain, which recognised the State of Palestine last year, cited Israeli government-backed projects to expand settlements and rising settler attacks targeting Palestinians in the West Bank. The British sanctions are to take effect next year. France and Canada [USN:S8N3X105I TEXT:"joined"] in announcing sanctions. Israel has not taken action against Paris or Ottawa. The incident highlighted growing frustration among Israel's longtime allies over its settlements in the occupied West Bank, territory Israel captured in a 1967 war. Nearly all countries and all UN bodies view the settlements as illegal under international law, which Israel disputes. (This story has been corrected to say 'fifth source,' not 'fourth source,' in paragraph 10.)

item.description: [パリ ６日 ロイター] - フランスのレスキュール経済・財務相は６日、同国の国債市場の混乱について、資金調達環境の...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
仏国債市場の混乱、ＴＰＩ活用を検討する段階でない＝財務相 16:22 配信

フランスのレスキュール経済・財務相。10月1日、パリのエリゼ宮で撮影。REUTERS/Sarah Meyssonnier

[パリ ６日 ロイター] - フランスのレスキュール経済・財務相は６日、同国の国債市場の混乱について、資金調達環境の安定に向けて欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）の伝達保護措置（ＴＰＩ）の活用を検討する段階には至っていないとの認識を示した。

記者団に「もちろん何としてもそうした事態を避けることが目標だ。だからこそ現在、財政健全化を重視している」と語った。

ＴＰＩは市場の圧力に直面したユーロ加盟国の国債を、健全な経済政策の維持を条件に買い入れる制度。

レスキュール氏は「信認の低下によって投資家が仏国債を売っているのではなく、買い手が減っている 」との見方を示した。

仏国債市場の混乱がユーロへの不信につながっている兆候は見られないと指摘した。足元の世界的な売りの中でも、ドイツ国債のパフォーマンスは最も良好な部類に入ると述べた。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：米政府、借り入れコスト抑制へ選択肢狭まる　歳出削減以外ならインフレ加速も 焦点：仏国債下落がユーロ安に波及、選挙年控えＥＣＢの対応に注目 コラム：進む米中デカップリング、中国「保有米国債」の脅威減退か コラム：米国債の「ベーシス取引」、軟着陸は可能か コラム：米財務省の借入拡大、債務問題の大きさに比べれば単なるノイズ 最終更新: 10/6(火) 16:57 ロイター

item.title: 利上げの時期やペース、中心見通しの実現確度やリスク点検し検討＝植田日銀総裁
item.description:
Takahiko Wada
[東京 ６日 ロイター] - 日銀の植田和男総裁は６日、全国証券大会であいさつし、基調的...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
利上げの時期やペース、中心見通しの実現確度やリスク点検し検討＝植田日銀総裁 16:20 配信

日銀本店。9月18日、都内で撮影。REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon

Takahiko Wada

[東京 ６日 ロイター] - 日銀の植田和男総裁は６日、全国証券大会であいさつし、基調的な物価上昇率が２％に近づいている中、金融環境が緩和的なことを踏まえれば「経済・物価・金融情勢に応じて、引き続き政策金利を引き上げ、金融緩和度合いを調整していくことになる」と述べた。その上で、政策調整のタイミングやペースは、経済・物価の中心的な見通しが実現する確度やリスクを点検しながら検討していくとした。

基調物価が２％を超えて上振れていくリスクが顕在化し、その後の経済に悪影響を及ぼすことがないよう「基調的な物価上昇率を２％程度の水準で安定させていくという観点が、これまでよりも重要になってきている」と述べた。

経済・物価は、展望リポートで示してきた「中心的な見通しにおおむね沿って推移している」とし、景気は「中東情勢の影響もあって一部に弱めの動きもみられるが、緩やかに回復している」と述べた。１日発表の９月短観について、企業の業況感は「良好な水準」だと評価した。一方、中長期の予想物価上昇率は引き続き上昇しており、「消費者物価の基調的な上昇率は２％に近づいている」と話した。

中心的見通しを巡るリスク要因としては、中東情勢や人工知能（ＡＩ）関連需要の拡大、為替変動を挙げた。

植田総裁は９月の利上げ後も「緩和的な金融環境は維持されるため、引き続き経済活動をしっかりとサポートしていく」とも述べた。

item.content:encoded:
ドイツ鉱工業受注、8月は10.6％減　大型案件が影響 16:17 配信

メルセデス・ベンツのエンジン工場。ベルリンで6月9日撮影。REUTERS/Axel Schmidt

Maria Martinez

[６日 ロイター] - ドイツ連邦統計庁が６日発表した８月の鉱工業受注は、季節・営業日調整済みで前月比１０．６％減少し、ロイターがまとめたアナリスト予想（１．０％減）よりもマイナス幅が大きくなった。航空機、船舶、鉄道車両、軍用車両への大規模な受注が減少した。

「その他の輸送用機器」が６１．５％減少。７月に同分野の受注は２倍以上に増加していた。

大型案件を除くと、８月の新規受注は０．１％減。

変動が平準化される３カ月間の比較では、６─８月の新規受注は、直前の３カ月間と比べて１．３％増加した。

７月の新規受注（改定値）は前月比３．２％増加。速報値（２．５％増）から上方改定された。

８月の海外受注は５．４％減。ユーロ圏からの受注は５．４％減、ユーロ圏以外からの受注は５．５％減となった。

国内受注は１７．３％減少した。

item.title: BOJ chief calls for more focus on anchoring inflation around target
item.description: Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda said on Tuesday it was becoming more important to anchor underlying inflation around the central bank's 2% target, signalling readiness to keep raising interest rates to blunt the risk of too-high inflation.
item.dc:creator: Leika Kihara
item.content:encoded: Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda said on Tuesday it was becoming more important to anchor underlying inflation around the central bank's 2% target, signalling readiness to keep raising interest rates to blunt the risk of too-high inflation. The remarks come ahead of the central bank's two-day policy meeting ending on October 30, where new quarterly growth and inflation forecasts will be closely watched for clues on the timing of the next rate hike. Ueda said economic and price developments were broadly in line with the BOJ's forecasts, with the economy recovering moderately and the central bank's "tankan" survey pointing to solid business sentiment. Rising raw material costs are pushing up wholesale inflation with price pressures spreading to consumer inflation, Ueda said, adding that long-term inflation expectations continue to rise. He also warned of the risk of underlying inflation overshooting the BOJ's target due to price pressures from the US-Israeli war on Iran, strong AI-related demand and the weak yen. "Financial conditions remain accommodative and continue to underpin economic activity" even after last month's rate hike, Ueda said, adding that the central bank will continue to raise borrowing costs to adjust the level of monetary support. "It has become more important than before to ensure underlying inflation becomes anchored around 2%" so that the risk of an inflation overshoot does not materialise and damage the economy, he added. In a statement announcing the September rate hike, the BOJ said only that it was "important" to anchor underlying inflation around the BOJ's target. The BOJ raised its key rate to a 31-year high [USN:L1N459138 TEXT:"last month"], with Ueda signalling the central bank had entered a phase focused on preventing underlying inflation from overshooting its target, raising the prospect of tighter policy.

item.title: One year on, Trump's Gaza plan has not stopped Israeli fire or disarmed Hamas
item.description: Some goals including disarming Hamas, securing Israeli withdrawal and rebuilding Gaza, appear far from reach.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump’s year-old plan to end the Gaza war has stalled, with Israel mounting near daily attacks and occupying around two-thirds of the shattered enclave where Palestinians face dire conditions. The initial phase resulted in a ceasefire on October 10, 2025 and secured the release of the last remaining hostages seized in Hamas’ 2023 attacks on Israel, along with freedom for hundreds of Palestinian prisoners and detainees held by Israel. But other goals, including [USN:L8N4470D5 TEXT:"disarming Hamas, securing Israeli withdrawal"] and rebuilding Gaza, appear far from reach. WHAT WAS IN THE PLAN? The first phase of Trump’s 20-point plan included a suspension of all military operations, Israeli withdrawal from part of the enclave, hostage and prisoner releases and a surge in aid. Later phases foresaw Hamas disarming and new governance by a Palestinian body overseen by the Trump-led Board of Peace. Israel would gradually withdraw, handing territory to a temporary International Stabilization Force (ISF). “Gaza will be redeveloped for the benefit of the people of Gaza, who have suffered more than enough,” the plan said. HAS THE CEASEFIRE HELD? There has been no return to full-scale military operations, but Israeli strikes have continued. Gaza's health ministry says at least 1,400 Palestinians have been killed since the October ceasefire, many of them women and children, although it does not disclose militant casualties. Israel says its strikes have targeted Hamas, accusing the group of trying to carry out attacks and rearm. Hamas denies this. Five Israeli soldiers have been killed by Palestinian militants or in combat since the ceasefire, according to the Israeli military. HOW MUCH OF GAZA DOES ISRAEL OCCUPY TODAY? Most of it. The initial phase of Trump’s plan foresaw Israel withdrawing to a so-called “yellow line” that left Israeli troops in control of 53% of Gaza. Since then, the Israeli military has expanded its effective control to [USN:L8N41B0LB TEXT:"around two-thirds"] of the territory. The [USN:L8N43T1U7 TEXT:"advancing yellow line"] has uprooted more Palestinians, squeezing the population of 2 million into a shrinking coastal strip where they shelter in tents and damaged buildings. Israel-backed Palestinian militias opposing Hamas use the Israeli-held zone to launch attacks into Hamas-controlled areas. HAVE AID FLOWS IMPROVED? Yes, but aid groups say it isn't enough. Global hunger watchdog IPC says more than [USN:L6N43P1EC TEXT:"1.2 million people"] still face acute hunger in Gaza despite a major scale-up of aid operations after the ceasefire. In an August report, it cited data showing that an average of 227 trucks a day carried humanitarian and commercial supplies into Gaza from the ceasefire to the end of May - less than half the minimum 600 trucks stipulated in the Gaza plan. COGAT, the Israeli military agency that controls access to Gaza, did not immediately respond to a request for comment on the figure cited in the IPC report. Israel says around 600 trucks carrying humanitarian aid and commercial goods are entering each day, that Gaza is getting enough goods to meet needs, and that it is meeting its obligations. Aid agencies say Israel is blocking essential items, including metal tent poles, engine oil and spare parts, from entering Gaza, on the grounds that Hamas could use them for military purposes. IS HAMAS READY TO DISARM? It has indicated so, but a plan unveiled in July to achieve this has also stalled. Trump said Hamas and other Gaza militants had accepted a 15-point [USN:L8N4470D5 TEXT:"roadmap"] drawn up by the Board of Peace to give up their arms. Israeli forces would withdraw as Hamas disarmed. The ISF, working with a new Palestinian security force, would secure Gaza. Trump called it historic. Hamas said it had agreed to hand over its weapons to be stored under the control of the US-backed Palestinian technocratic government. Though Hamas rejected the word ‘disarmament’, this marked a once-unimaginable position for the Iran-backed group. But Israel, skeptical that Hamas will give up its arms, called the plan unacceptable and said it would not carry out any withdrawal until Hamas is fully disarmed. HAS THE ISF BEEN FORMED? Plans have taken shape but it has yet to be assembled. There is a commander - US Major General Jasper Jeffers - and Indonesia, Morocco, Kazakhstan, Albania, Kosovo, and [USN:L8N44328X TEXT:"Uganda"] have [USN:L1N3ZF0VI TEXT:"committed personnel"]. Jeffers has said the long-term plan is for the ISF to use 20,000 troops and train 12,000 Palestinian police. The technocratic Palestinian governing body, the National Committee for the Administration of Gaza, was appointed in January led by Ali Shaath, who formerly served as a deputy minister in the Ramallah-based Palestinian Authority. It has yet to enter Gaza. WHAT ABOUT RECONSTRUCTION? A year on, Palestinians are still scavenging in the rubble of [USN:L8N45B09K TEXT:"wrecked buildings"] for materials to prop up tents and other shelters. The Board of Peace unveiled a [USN:L1N45F09E TEXT:"$2.45 billion plan"] in September to begin rebuilding Gaza. That is a fraction of what is needed. The Board of Peace cited an EU and UN assessment released in April that estimated recovery and reconstruction needs at $71.4 billion over the next decade. WHAT ARE ISRAELI POLITICIANS SAYING ABOUT GAZA’S FUTURE? While the Trump plan promises to encourage people to stay in Gaza, Israeli right-wing politicians have stepped up calls for the mass removal of Palestinians through “voluntary emigration”. Israeli Defence Minister Israel Katz said last month there was "[USN:L6N44W0HN TEXT:"no real solution"] for Gaza in the end without this migration". Israel's defence ministry in 2025 established an office tasked with overseeing “voluntary emigration” from Gaza, after comments by Trump suggesting Gazans [USN:S0N3OH00C TEXT:"could be permanently displaced"]. Trump later backed away from the idea, which faced strong resistance from Arab states and was widely rejected internationally. Israeli officials have said there are no plans to move Gaza's population out by force. Israel will hold a general election on October 27, the country's first since the October 7, 2023, Hamas attack. Some leading opposition figures have spoken in support of Trump's plan. Polls show pro- and anti-Netanyahu parties in a tight race.

item.title: Brazil ex-President Bolsonaro wins big without his name on the ballot
item.description: Flavio Bolsonaro's shock victory represented a stunning reversal of his father's fortunes as the rehabilitated Bolsonaro family and ideological movement emerged stronger than ever.
item.dc:creator: Luciana Magalhaes, Ricardo Brito
item.content:encoded: The biggest winner in Brazil's blockbuster weekend election did not even appear on the ballot. [USN:L1N38M126 TEXT:"Banned from public office"], former President Jair Bolsonaro is under house arrest, serving a [USN:S0N3UJ08N TEXT:"27-year sentence"] for a coup plot after his 2022 election loss. The 71-year-old watched from confinement on Sunday as his eldest son, Senator Flavio Bolsonaro, scored an upset victory over leftist President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva in the first round of the presidential election. The result, which pundits linked to a right-wing wave sweeping the region and Lula's own campaign missteps, made Flavio the favorite to win second-round voting on October 25. The shock victory represented a stunning reversal of his father's fortunes as the rehabilitated Bolsonaro family and ideological movement emerged stronger than ever. Candidates from Bolsonaro's right-wing Liberal Party won up and down the ballot, demonstrating growing traction for the brand despite his legal woes, which the new [USN:L1N45L166 TEXT:"right-wing Congress"] could resolve when it takes office in January. Along with Flavio's surprising success, four more members of the family won public office on Sunday including Senate seats for Michelle Bolsonaro, the ex-president's wife, and second son Carlos while brother Renato and youngest son Jair Renan took seats in the lower house. "In Brazilian political history, I do not remember any political clan that ever managed to elect so many members all at once," said political analyst Antonio Flavio Testa, who served on the former president's transition team in 2018. When the imprisoned ex-president [USN:L1N3XB0QD TEXT:"tapped his son"] to run for Brazil's highest office in December, markets tumbled and center-right allies turned up their noses. Flavio enlisted a little-known lawmaker from his own party, Alfredo Gaspar, as running mate because no other major party would join the ticket. Flavio's most important ally could not appear in public even virtually to campaign for him but still loomed large over the race. An AI-generated avatar of the elder Bolsonaro gave a [USN:L1N43T0Q4 TEXT:"controversial endorsement"] of Flavio at his campaign launch. The real Jair Bolsonaro has moved from serving his sentence in prison to house arrest since March due to ill health including complications from a 2018 stabbing. The Supreme Court prohibited visits from his eldest son for the past three months. Their Liberal Party nearly doubled its bloc in the 81-seat Senate on Sunday to 28 seats, [USN:L6N45R137 TEXT:"the strongest result for a party"] since Brazil's constitution was enacted in the 1980s after the country's return to democracy. That will put amnesty for the elder Bolsonaro at the top of Congress' agenda next year, according to a close aide of Flavio who requested anonymity to speak openly. A vote on the matter could come even sooner if Flavio wins and the current Congress decides to curry favor with the incoming government. Flavio said in early September that he hoped he would be inaugurated with his father present. "I ask God for the opportunity to walk up the ramp of Planalto Palace next year alongside President Jair Messias Bolsonaro," he said. Bolsonaro and Lula, who got 47% and 45% of Sunday's vote respectively, go head-to-head in a second-round vote that political consulting firm Think Policy said would be "very difficult, but not impossible" for Lula to win. To do that, Lula needs to get 62% of voters who backed conservative candidates other than Flavio in the first round, Think Policy estimated. With prospects for Flavio's victory promising, Liberal Party President Valdemar da Costa Neto told Reuters that the elder Bolsonaro could once again play a role in government under his son.

item.title: Britain Has Found a Politician Who Actually Knows Finance: Andrew Griffith
item.description: If Andrew Griffith wanted to write a guide on how not to run an economy, he has lots of examples from his fairly short stint in British politics. His first Westminster job in 2019 was for then Prime Minister Boris Johnson, the man who secured the financially ruinous Brexit and who reportedly once uttered, “ F**k business.” Three years later Griffith served at the Treasury during the mercifully short premiership of Liz Truss, who destroyed the country’s credibility with the bond markets.

item.description:
Hiroko Hamada
[東京 ６日 ロイター] - 東京株式市場で日経平均は続伸し、前営業日比１．０５％（７３７...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
日経平均は続伸、原油安など支え　業績期待の買いも 15:59 配信

写真は2024年12月、都内の東京証券取引所で撮影。REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon

Hiroko Hamada

[東京 ６日 ロイター] - 東京株式市場で日経平均は続伸し、前営業日比１．０５％（７３７円１２銭）高の７万０６８３円９８銭で取引を終えた。前日上昇した反動でマイナスに沈む場面もあったが、原油安などを背景にしっかりの展開が続いた。企業決算シーズンを前に業績期待も意識され、一部の半導体関連株や電子部品関連株が買われた。

日経平均は前営業日比０．０１％高でスタートした後、一時小幅安に転じたが、その後はすぐに切り返しプラス圏で推移した。寄与度の高い一部の半導体関連や電子部品関連、主力株の一角が堅調で相場を押し上げた。個別材料を手掛かりにした物色も活発だった。

後場に入ると日経平均は一段高となり、終盤に一時１．２２％（８５１円）高の７万０７９８円６２銭まで上昇。プライム市場では８割近くの銘柄が上昇するなど、相場全体が底堅い地合いとなった。ＴＯＰＩＸもしっかりだった。

マネックス証券のチーフ・マーケット・アナリスト、吉野貴晶氏は「米雇用統計が弱い結果となり、米国の早期利上げ観測が後退したという材料でここまで株価が上昇するのは意外感もある」と指摘。「相場の底堅さは維持されているものの、さらに上方向を試すためには別の材料が必要になる」とみている。

ＴＯＰＩＸは０．９２％高の４１８３．５６ポイントで取引を終えた。東証プライム市場指数は前営業日比０．９２％高の２１５７．０９ポイント。プライム市場の売買代金は７兆３０４８億２７００万円だった。東証３３業種では、非鉄金属、精密機器、銀行など３０業種が値上がり。情報・通信、建設、空運は値下がりした。

新興株式市場では、東証グロース市場２５０指数が続伸し、１．４１％高の８２３．７１ポイントだった。

個別では、アドバンテストは連日の上場来高値。ＴＤＫ、太陽誘電、フジクラは大幅高だった。企業などへの不正アクセスが頻発する中、セグエグループ、ソリトンシステムズなどサイバーセキュリティ関連も上昇。キオクシアホールディングス、ソフトバンクグループは軟調だった。

東証プライム市場の騰落数は、値上がりが１１５３銘柄（７４％）、値下がりは３４９銘柄（２２％）、変わらずは５０銘柄（３％）だった。

item.title: Argentina, Uruguay, Chile and Brazil submit joint bid to host 2035 World Cup
item.description: Argentina, Uruguay, Chile and Brazil have submitted a joint bid to host the Rugby World Cup in 2035, hoping to bring the quadrennial tournament to South America for the first time, the Argentine Rugby Union (UAR) said on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Argentina, Uruguay, Chile and Brazil have submitted a joint bid to host the Rugby World Cup in 2035, hoping to bring the quadrennial tournament to South America for the first time, the Argentine Rugby Union (UAR) said on Monday. The bid outlines plans to stage games in 11 stadiums across 10 cities, with eight venues in Argentina and one each in the other three countries, including the iconic Maracana in Rio de Janeiro. Spain and Japan have also expressed interest in hosting the tournament. World Rugby will undertake site visits and feasibility assessments before identifying a preferred host by next May, with a final decision expected in November 2027. "We have the opportunity to show the world our passion for this sport, our ability to host major events, and everything our countries have to offer," UAR President Felix Paez Molina said in a statement. "We take on this challenge firmly believing that our region deserves an opportunity of this size. "It's a project we're excited about, and we're building it together with the region's Unions and Sudamerica Rugby. Our hope is that, for the first time, a Rugby World Cup can be played in this part of the world." The next World Cup will be held in Australia in 2027, with the tournament making its first foray into the Americas in 2031 when it will be hosted by the United States. Argentina are the most successful rugby-playing nation in the Americas with the Pumas having reached the semi-finals of the World Cup three times in 2007, 2015 and 2023. Uruguay have competed at five editions, while Chile made their debut in 2023 and Brazil have yet to qualify for the tournament.

item.title: Drone sinks ship in Bulgaria's Black Sea - media reports
item.description: Drones sunk one ship and damaged another in the Black Sea off Bulgaria on Tuesday, local media reports said.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Drones sunk one ship and damaged another in the Black Sea off Bulgaria on Tuesday, local media reports said. The reports said that the vessels were merchant ships. It was not clear if anyone was injured or killed and a rescue operation was underway, they said. The office of President Iliana Iotova confirmed the attack in the NATO member in an emailed statement, but did not provide details. It is not yet clear who was responsible and the government declined to comment. Prime Minister Rumen Radev is convening a meeting today with key ministries and the security services over the attack and is expected to issue a statement. The drone attack comes after [USN:L1N45R0CZ TEXT:"two people died"] on a ship in the Black Sea outside Romania's territorial waters. Since the Ukraine-Russia war started four years ago, European countries have seen Russian drones breaching their airspace as well as mines floating in the Black Sea across key trade and energy routes.

item.description: The Thai government has asked companies to cut egg exports by up to 50 per cent, after millions of hens died during heavy flooding.
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

Asia

Thailand asks firms to cut egg exports after flood losses

The Thai government has asked companies to cut egg exports by up to 50 per cent, after millions of hens died during heavy flooding.

File photo of a chicken on a farm. (Photo: AP/Erin Hooley, File)

06 Oct 2026 02:44PM (Updated: 06 Oct 2026 03:29PM)

FAST

BANGKOK: Thailand has asked companies to cut egg exports by 30 per cent to 50 per cent until December 2026, with supplies hit by heavy flooding, which killed a significant number of hens, a commerce ministry official said on Tuesday (Oct 6). In the flood-hit egg farms in the area of Chachoengsao province, about two hours east of the capital Bangkok, about 3 million hens were killed, said Jirawuth Suwanna-arj, deputy director-general of the Department of Internal Trade. The department is urgently surveying unaffected areas to source eggs for distribution to retailers. It is also working with other agencies to extend the lifespan of laying hens from 80 weeks to 85 weeks to maintain egg supplies, Jirawuth said. Since Sep 16, there has been flooding in 51 provinces , including Bangkok , with 31 people killed, according to the Interior Ministry.

Bangkok was declared a disaster-affected zone late last month after receiving 320mm of rain over three days, as much as it typically receives in all of September.

The department has asked the Egg Producers Association and major farms to maintain the farm-gate price at 4 baht (US$0.12) per egg, Jirawuth added. He has also asked egg collectors to source eggs from unaffected areas and distribute them to retailers, while cooperating on maintaining prices. Last year, Thailand exported 1.7 billion baht (US$50.46 million) worth of eggs, mostly to Singapore, which accounted for 79 per cent of the total, with Hong Kong receiving 9 per cent, according to agriculture ministry data. From Oct 9 to Oct 13, Thailand's eastern and central regions, including Bangkok and its suburbs, as well as parts of the south, are expected to experience an increase in rainfall, with heavy rain in some places, according to the weather agency.

item.title: アングル：米政府、借り入れコスト抑制へ選択肢狭まる 歳出削減以外ならインフレ加速も
item.description:
Karen Brettell
[５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Karen Brettell

[５日 ロイター] - 米長期国債の利回りが約２０年ぶりの高水準に近づく中、米政府は借り入れコストの抑制策に手詰まり感を強めている。今後、より強い政策対応に踏み込む可能性があるが、そうした対応はインフレをあおり、債券保有者に損失をもたらす恐れもある。

長期国債利回りの上昇要因は、一時的なものとは言い難い。米政府は財政赤字を賄うために大量の国債を発行しているが、赤字は縮小していない。インフレ沈静化のペースも鈍い。さらに、人工知能（ＡＩ）投資ブームによって景気が堅調を維持しているため、住宅・自動車市場が弱含んでいるにもかかわらず、金利は低下していない。

その結果、政府債務は４０兆ドルを超え、年間の利払い費は約１兆ドル（約１５８兆１０００億円）に上る。

借り入れコストを抑えるには、短期借り入れへの依存を高めることから、最も踏み込んだケースでは米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が長期金利に上限を設けることまで、さまざまな手段がある。ただ、政策当局がこうした手段に深入りするほど、インフレをあおるリスクが高まり、債券保有者の受ける打撃が大きくなる恐れがある。

アポロ・グローバル・マネジメントのチーフエコノミスト、トルステン・スロック氏によると、政府税収５ドルに対して１ドルが国債の利払いに充てられている。同氏は「これは極めて高い水準で、今後も増加し続けるだろう」と述べた。

トランプ大統領は９月２８日、米誌タイムのインタビューで、債務は経済成長やインフレなどを通じて返済できると述べた。

しかし、それで問題が解決しなければ、米財務省には穏健なものから抜本的なものまで、ほかにも選択肢がある。同省はすでに短期国債への依存を強めており、国債市場の流動性を支えるために国債の小規模な買い入れ消却（バイバック）も実施している。

さらに状況が悪化した場合、次の段階ではＦＲＢの対応が必要になる。１つは、１９６１年の「オペレーション・ツイスト」に似た形で長期国債を大規模に買い入れること。もう１つは長期金利に明確な上限を設定することで、米国は第二次世界大戦以来こうした措置を採ったことがない。政策当局がこうした選択肢に踏み込んでいくほど、金利抑制の効果は高まるが、同時にインフレを悪化させるリスクも高まる。

ダブルライン・キャピタルのジェフリー・ガンドラック最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は最近のイベントで、「政府が目に見えて金利水準を懸念する段階に来た」と述べた。

＜オペレーション・ツイスト＞

過去に実施された政策を踏まえると、次の段階の政策対応はオペレーション・ツイストの本格的な復活になる公算が大きい。これは１９６１年に実施された政策で、短期債を売却する一方、長期債を購入することでイールドカーブ（利回り曲線）をフラット化することを狙った。

本格的なオペレーション・ツイストにはＦＲＢの協力が不可欠とみられる。ただ、明確な金融危機が発生しない限り、ＦＲＢは動かないかもしれない。スロック氏は、ＦＲＢのバランスシートを使わない限り、財務省は「金利を引き下げるための手段が限られる」と指摘する。

しかしＦＲＢのウォーシュ議長は、ＦＲＢが保有する米国債など証券の残高が膨らんでいることを批判してきた。大規模な国債買い入れは、金融政策と政府の債務管理との境界を曖昧にしかねないと主張。財務省とＦＲＢが新たな合意（アコード）を結び、ＦＲＢ議長と財務長官がＦＲＢのバランスシートと財務省の国債発行について、目標を公に説明する仕組みを提唱している。

＜イールドカーブ・コントロール＞

オペレーション・ツイスト型国債買い入れでも十分な効果が得られなければ、次の手段は明示的な「イールドカーブ・コントロール（ＹＣＣ）」となるだろう。ＹＣＣでは中銀が長期金利を一定の上限以下に抑えるため、国債を無制限に買い入れると約束する。ＦＲＢは第二次世界大戦の戦費調達と戦後復興を支えるため、１９４２年から５１年の財務省・ＦＲＢ合意まで米長期国債の利回りを２．５％に抑えていた。日銀は２０１６年から２４年にかけてＹＣＣを実施した。

ＹＣＣは金利を人為的に低く抑えることで、財政赤字拡大に伴う政治的な痛みを和らげる。しかし、この政策が機能するのは、投資家が政府から「インフレによって価値が目減りしたドル」での返済を懸念しないことが条件になる。この信認が崩れれば、金利を押し下げるために行う国債買い入れが、かえってインフレを加速させる可能性がある。

ジョージ・メイソン大学マーケタス・センターのシニア・リサーチフェロー、ベロニク・ド・ルジー氏は、債務問題を根本的に解決する唯一の方法は歳出削減だと指摘。「議会は財政調整を行う必要がある。つまり、緊縮財政だ。これはＦＲＢだけでは対応できない」と述べた。

＜２つの道筋＞

キャピタル・エコノミクスのチーフ経済顧問、ジョン・ヒギンズ氏によると、米国が第二次世界大戦後に政府債務残高の対国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）比を大幅に引き下げたのは２回だけで、国債保有者が受けた影響はそれぞれ大きく異なった。

戦後には、政府債務のＧＤＰ比率が１９４６年の約１０６パーセントから７４年には２３％まで低下した一方、１０年国債利回りは２．２％から７．５％へ上昇した。これに対して、１９９０年代には債務のＧＤＰ比率が４８％から３２％へ低下し、国債利回りもこれに伴って低下した。

何が違いを生んだのか。戦後は、借入コストに上限が設けられ、比較的高いインフレ率によって、名目成長率が米国債利回りを上回った。その結果、大幅な財政規律を伴わなくても債務比率を低下させることができた。一方、１９９０年代には、金利が経済成長率をやや上回っていたため、歳出抑制と歳入増加が債務比率の低下をもたらした。

現在の選択肢も、この２つの道筋に沿う。金利低下を伴う緊縮財政か、人為的な金利抑制とインフレによって債務比率を改善させる道だ。後者では、債務比率が改善しても利回りは上昇し得る。

現在は１９９０年代と比べて、予算に占める義務的経費の割合が大きい。また、議会は増税や歳出削減を望んでいない。このためヒギンズ氏は、リスクは「債券保有者に打撃を与えるインフレ経路に傾いている」とみている。

item.title: 午後3時のドルは158円前半でもみあい、日銀総裁の発言に関心向かう
item.description:
Kentaro Sugiyama
[東京 ６日 ロイター] -
...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
午後3時のドルは158円前半でもみあい、日銀総裁の発言に関心向かう 15:28 配信

写真は１ドル紙幣。2021年11月撮影。REUTERS/Murad Sezer

Kentaro Sugiyama

[東京 ６日 ロイター] -

ドル／円 ユーロ／ドル ユーロ／円

午後３時現在 158.07／158.08 1.1213／1.1215 177.26／177.27

午前９時現在 157.94／157.98 1.1214／1.1220 177.18／177.19

ＮＹ午後５時 157.90／157.94 1.1221／1.1225 177.18／177.21

午後３時のドルは、前日ニューヨーク市場終盤に比べてややドル高／円安の１５８円前半で推移している。フランスの財政懸念などを背景とした欧州発のリスクオフでドルと円がともに買われる流れとなったが、日米金利差が意識される中で、相対的にドル買いがやや優勢となった。

ドル／円は午前１０時半頃に１５７．７８円の安値を付けた後、じり高となり、午後２時半前に高値の１５８．２１円を付けた。もっとも、日米当局が円安是正に向けて協調姿勢を示しており、積極的に上値は追いづらい状況で、午後３時にかけては伸び悩んだ。

トレイダーズ証券の井口喜雄・市場部長は「日米の協調行動が意識されて上値は攻め込めない一方、日米金利差が意識され、下値はしっかり買われる。この一週間ほどは大きなレンジが続き、方向感はあまり出ていない」と話す。

市場では、この後の植田和男日銀総裁のあいさつで動意づくか注目されている。次の利上げに前向きな見解を示すようなタカ派的な内容なら円買いにつながるとの見方もあるが、これまでの見解を踏襲する発言にとどまるとの予想も聞かれた。

HONG KONG/TOKYO, Oct 6 : Blackstone, Bain Capital and Warburg Pincus are among global investors expected to submit final bids for the property unit of Japanese broadcaster Fuji Media by the end of this month, said two people with knowledge of the sale. Fuji Media expects a deal would value the unit at around 1 trillion yen ($6.3 billion) including debt, said the people, adding that BGO, a real estate investment firm under Canada's Sun Life Financial, also plans to submit a binding offer for the unit, Sankei Building. If the entire unit is sold, it would mark one of Japan's largest-ever real estate takeovers. A Fuji Media shareholder, however, has urged greater transparency in the Sankei Building transaction, according to a September 30 letter seen by Reuters.

In the letter to Fuji Media's group CEO Kenji Shimizu, Vasanta Master Fund argued that the size and complexity of the real estate portfolio could limit potential buyers to a handful of large private equity firms, which may not result in enough upside for existing shareholders. Vasanta Master Fund, which owns less than 1 per cent of Fuji Media shares, requested more disclosure on the value of Sankei's assets, the transaction structure and options such as a partial sale, a spin-off or a phased sale of individual assets, and the use of proceeds. "There is a fair bit of uncertainty regarding Fuji Media's intentions — whether they will sell 100 per cent or just a part. The price will be better if they sell all of it," said Travis Lundy, an analyst at Quiddity Advisors who publishes on Smartkarma. Fuji Media is expected to seek shareholders' approval after choosing a preferred bidder, said one of the people and a separate person. The people declined to be named as the information is confidential. Fuji Media said in a statement "the method, scale, timing, and other details" of possible investments in its property unit were being evaluated, and it would make an announcement once a decision has been taken. Blackstone, Bain and Warburg Pincus declined to comment. BGO did not respond to a Reuters request for comment. ROBUST JAPANESE MARKET The interest from global investment firms to acquire Sankei Building underscores Japan's status as one of the hottest real estate markets, thanks to strong demand for office tenancy and openness to foreign ownership and a weak yen. Land prices rose 1.5 per cent in the year to July 1, marking a fifth straight year of gains and maintaining the strongest pace of growth since the aftermath of the country's asset-price bubble more than three decades ago. Mergers and acquisitions targeting Japanese real estate assets totalled $15.5 billion as of October 5, up 45 per cent year-on-year and the highest level for the same period since 2013, LSEG data showed. The planned divestment of the property unit comes after Fuji Media faced pressure to offload real estate assets and unwind cross-shareholdings from activist investors including US-based Dalton Investments and funds linked to veteran Japanese activist Yoshiaki Murakami. In 2024 a Dalton affiliate said Fuji Media should consider going private — an option more Japanese firms are taking after the Tokyo Stock Exchange put in place stricter governance criteria. In February, the broadcaster bought back about 30 per cent of its shares or 235 billion yen's worth, allowing major activist shareholders to exit, and announced it would begin considering divesting its real estate holdings, including Sankei Building.

Source: Reuters
